info.title: Secret Sources API
info.description: Pull host passwords and keys from 1Password when you connect instead of storing them in Termix.

bearerAuth.description: Session token sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the token.

cookieAuth.name: jwt
cookieAuth.description: Session JWT cookie set at sign-in. When present, it takes precedence over the Authorization header.

apiKeyAuth.description: API key sent in the Authorization header as Bearer and the key, which starts with tmx_. It acts as the key owner and cannot act as anyone else.

get.summary: List secret sources visible to the caller (own + shared)

post.description: Sharing a source with every user requires admin. The token is encrypted with the owner's data key.

put.summary: Update a secret source (owner only; omit token to keep it)

post.summary: Check that the source is reachable and the token is accepted
